title: oncidium × kraenzlinii
intro: Oncidium × kraenzlinii, commonly known as the 'Kraenzlin's Oncidium', is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the Oncidiinae subtribe. This plant is known for its unique and delicate flowers, which exhibit a wide range of colors and patterns. The health benefits of Oncidium × kraenzlinii include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
